name: Shibayan Records Music Pack
teaser: Favorite Music mod I've uploaded tbh
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds Touhou Circle Shibayan Records Music the majority of it to SPT. All music belongs to Shibayan Circle and OG Music ie original belongs to ZUN.

Install: Drag BepinEx folder to SPT directory

Mod requires Bobby’s Main Menu mod

Preview: https://youtu.be/CCdHXQoJUKQ?si=f47_ZrzQKwQW1Y_d

Updated to SPT 3.11 version
